name: You
role: The channel's recurring point-of-view avatar for 'You wake up in…' episodes. Same face in every era; only the costume changes.
personality: Curious, quick to react, a little out of their depth, never stupid. Silent: the narrator speaks to them.

signature.silhouette: Messy chestnut hair with a single upright cowlick; big amber eyes; freckles.
signature.gesture: Scratches the back of the head when confused; clutches the purse when worried.

eras.england-1260: Knee-length undyed wool tunic, leather belt with purse, wool hose, turnshoes; linen braies underneath (not visible).

kokoro.notes: Kokoro bf_isabella (You does not speak in H01/H02; set for later episodes).
